subject: Forecast spotlight — action list for near-term stale opportunities
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast spotlight — action list for near-term stale opportunities

Team —

Quick pulse on a handful of high-dollar deals that are slipping our commit signal. Finance asked for a short action list today to preserve Q4 predictability. Please take 1 pass on the items below and reply with either: (A) stage/close-date update + proof link OR (B) "Archive / hold" reason if it's not progressing.

Priority list (pulled from SF filters -> Amount > $250k, past 30d no stage change):
- ACME-2892 (Acme Health) — currently Negotiation, close date 2026-11-30, last activity 10/08
- STELL-1147 (Stellar Health) — currently Proposal, close date 2026-11-25, owner unassigned
- MEDV-207 (MedVantage) — currently Proof-of-Concept, close date 2026-12-10, awaiting security signoff

For ACME specifically: spending exposure is material to the forecast. Vanessa — can you confirm whether we have the signed commercial term sheet or at least a precise procurement cadence? If you don't have proof, mark it as at-risk and include the last customer touch.

Marcus — please add any pricing/finance blockers you see; if we need a temporary revenue hold to avoid overcommit, call it out. Priyom — if you can bundle any closeproofs (signed emails, DocuSign IDs) into a zip and drop the Drive link, that will speed reconciliation.

Goal: capture a definitive status by EOD today so finance can finalize the topline view. Short replies welcome.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: ACME-2892-evidence-checklist.pdf (stub)

Subject: Re: Forecast spotlight — action list for near-term stale opportunities

Gave the list a quick pass. High-level notes:
- ACME-2892: commercial terms verbally agreed; procurement timeline slipped because legal asked for a data residency exception. Finance is holding on recognizing until DocuSign or equivalent is in SF. No signed T&Cs in HubSpot.
- STELL-1147: owner was transferred last week — outreach planned Monday. Suggest setting close-date to 2026-12-15 until we have a firm PO date.
- MEDV-207: security gating — try to get a POC completion report by 11/20; otherwise mark as Product Eval with NO_COMMIT.

For ACME, I recommend we flag as "At-risk — evidence pending" for today's commit. If Vanessa can surface any email threads with procurement confirmation we can reclassify.

I'll stand by for the proof attachments.

—Marcus
Senior Account Executive

Hi all —

ACME-2892 update: I pulled the procurement thread. Summary:
- Customer legal asked for a limited data residency addendum on 10/12; our legal pushed back and asked ACME for the exact language they need (we don't have a signed addendum yet).
- Commercial term sheet: unsigned PDF shared on 10/01, counters requested 10/14. No DocuSign completed.
- Last customer contact: Lara Gomez (procurement) — 10/20 — said they were waiting for internal budget signoff (no date given).

I've uploaded what we have to Drive: closeproofs-ACME-2892.zip (contains exported email thread, term-sheet-draft.pdf). Link in the related links list.

Recommendation: label ACME-2892 as "At-risk — legal evidence pending" and move the expected close-date out to 2026-12-20 for forecasting until we get DocuSign. If finance wants to be conservative, we should remove it from commit for today's topline.

Also flagged STELL-1147 for owner reassignment and set a tentative close-date of 2026-12-15 in SF. MEDV-207 left as Product Eval until security confirms.

Attachment: closeproofs-ACME-2892.zip (stub)

Thanks,
Vanessa
Account Executive
